title: Approve event hub body composition
question: Continuous workbench is locked. Which composition should we build for Attendees, Listing, Forms, Images, and Settings?

options.label: Flush list plane
options.thesis: Edge-to-edge rows under a flush toolbar—Linear density, zero nested cards.
options.viewport: Attendees opens as people count + Add, hairline filters, full-width rows.
options.risk: Can feel sparse if empty states are weak.

options.label: List + inspector
options.thesis: Same flush list, with expand-in-place detail as the signature interaction.
options.viewport: Pending row opens Approve / Decline inline; Forms and Settings reuse expand grammar.
options.risk: Expanded rows get busy on small phones.

options.label: Shared stage
options.thesis: One document plane for Listing that teaches the flush grammar every ops tab inherits.
options.viewport: Listing leads with editable title and hairline metadata; ops tabs stay quieter clones.
options.risk: Attendees may feel secondary if Listing composition dominates.
